title: Schemes of splittings of vector-bundle extensions preserve ordinary etale cohomology
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, let $\ell$ be a prime invertible on $X$, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$. Let $0\to E'\xrightarrow{j}E\xrightarrow{q}E''\to0$ be a short exact sequence of finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. Pullback is [def-pc-module-pullback]. The functor assigning to an $X$-scheme $f:Y\to X$ the set of $\mathcal O_Y$-linear maps $s:f^*E''\to f^*E$ with $(f^*q)s=1$ is represented by an $X$-scheme $\rho:S\to X$. It carries the universal such map, so the pulled-back sequence is split. It is Zariski locally isomorphic over $X$ to $\mathbf A_X^{ab}$, where $a=\operatorname{rank}E'$ and $b=\operatorname{rank}E''$ on that open [def-sbc-affine-space]; the translation between two sections is a unique map $f^*E''\to f^*E'$ via $f^*j$. In particular $S$ is Noetherian. In the ordinary small-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the adjunction unit $\Lambda_X\to R\rho_*\Lambda_S$ is an isomorphism. Consequently for every integer $t$ and every $q\geq0$ the canonical pullback $H^q(X,\Lambda(t))\to H^q(S,\Lambda(t))$ is an isomorphism, with the roots-of-unity twist identifications of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. No regularity or field-of-definition condition is imposed on $X$.

source.place: Expose XVI, Proposition 1.5 (Principe de scindage II), including its representing scheme and constant-coefficient derived unit; the twisted consequence uses the locally free Tate lines.
